http/environment_proxy#

The proxy the environment names: http_proxy, https_proxy (or HTTPS_PROXY), all_proxy (or ALL_PROXY) and no_proxy (or NO_PROXY).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let proxy = EnvironmentProxy(Environment()).proxy(url);      // MissingProxy when none
Proxied(proxy: proxy, resolver: SystemResolution(), tls: tls, policy: ClientPolicy(), clock: SystemClock());

Description#

The proxy the environment names: http_proxy, https_proxy (or HTTPS_PROXY), all_proxy (or ALL_PROXY) and no_proxy (or NO_PROXY).

Uppercase HTTP_PROXY is ignored, as CGI servers set it from a request header.
